name: AI assistant
author: Brett
description: The Dev Console's AI assistant inside Molly, owned by Molly (build ai-assistant-in-molly-console-drives-by-api-open, Nov 10 2026: "Give Molly and the AI assistant access to the API so she can drive the console, open screens and configure settings. Easy to reach, hands free."). Frames the console plugin's own chat page (one plugin, one chat, every provider, the console control API and hands-free voice as the console has them) as a Molly view and a floating window, and tells the console frame it owns the assistant, so the console never draws a second copy inside Molly: Ask the assistant anywhere in the console opens Molly's window. Molly menu → AI assistant; the toolbar designer can place it; actions molly-assistant.open / molly-assistant.page / molly-assistant.hands-free.

commands.noReads: a web-only Molly plugin: it frames the console's assistant, whose API (/api/plugins/ai-assistant, MCP ai-assistant_*, CLI axf ai-assistant) is the one to read and command
